newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy specialist bond dealers rise to 15 from 13.
newsitem.headline: Italy specialist bond dealers rise to 15 from 13.

text.p: The number of specialist dealers operating on the secondary market for Italian government bonds (MTS) has been increased to 15 from 13, the Treasury and Bank of Italy said in a statement.

For the period July 1997 to June 1998, Credito Italiano, Imi-Sigeco and Lehman Brothers leave the list while those joining are Monte dei Paschi di Siena, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, Citibank, Goldman Sachs and Ing Bank.

The 10 specialists confirmed in their role are Banca Commerciale Italiana, Morgan Stanley, Banco di Napoli, Bank of America, Caboto securities house, Cariplo (Cassa di Risparmio delle Provincie Lombarde), CRT (Cassa di Risparmio di Torino), Deutsche Bank, Istituto San Paolo and Morgan Guaranty.

The specialist dealers who operate on the screen-based MTS are the real market makers in Italian bonds and must fulfil special trading requirements and strict obligations regarding the purchase primary issues.
The annual adjustment to the list is based on adherence to the operating criteria set by the Treasury and central bank during the course of the past 12 months.
